_comment: DE4SDV broker-path bench (INC-MW-011 phase 10), DRAFT, bench-only, not yet validated.
The DE4SDV stack configuration of the SDV Core VM. It replaces the reference
stack's /vendor/etc/someip/vsomeip_config.json. It offers no SOME/IP service.
It declares the frame service of someipd as a remote service with its
reliable endpoint pinned to the host (192.168.98.1), so a service-discovery
message from the IVI VM cannot redirect the subscription (else filter SD in
the SDV Core VM to the host, or record the residual under GAP-MW-012).
